items.title: Da Mumbo Jumbo blev kæmpestor - Deleted sequence
items.summary: Animatic for a danish feature film "When Mumbo Jumbo became huge"Director : Karsten KiilerichStudio : A FilmMade in Storyboard Pro, 2023.Mumbo Jumbo and his friends need to travel back home in a huge flying cup, provided by the witch Baba Yaga.
